title: Timeout + retry wrapper for per-turn model calls (Epic 6, orchestration §4)
prompt:
Implement a wrapper around every model call: enforce TURN_TIMEOUT_S, cancel on timeout, retry up to MAX_RETRIES with backoff; after exhaustion mark the turn failed and inform the controller. Log timeout/retry events.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: Per-turn timeout + retry wrapper (orchestration §4) — NOT the verdict/closing discussion (6.5/6.8). REUSES (no duplication): the search resilience layer's thread-based timeout helper (search/_timeout.py run_with_timeout — a daemon worker joined for timeout_s; on timeout TimeoutError is raised and the hung worker abandoned, the documented 'cancel' semantics for the synchronous run_sync path) and the gatekeeper's retry policy (gatekeeper/_retry.py run_with_retry/backoff_delay/is_transient). New file engine/_call.py: generate_turn_output(gatekeeper, api_call, *, message_history, service, config, run_id, round_, agent, runs_dir, sleep_fn=time.sleep, timeout_runner=thread-based) routes the call THROUGH gatekeeper.execute (every external call still does), bounds it by config.turn_timeout_s, retries transient failures (TimeoutError/ConnectionError) up to config.max_retries with exponential backoff (base = the gatekeeper service's retry_after_seconds, single source of truth), logs a 'timeout' event per timeout + a 'retry' event per retry, and on exhausted budget raises TurnFailedError after logging a 'system' event with payload {'turn_failed': 'model_call'} informing the controller; a NON-transient error (e.g. ValueError) is NOT wrapped/retried — it propagates raw. New file engine/_call_log.py: _CallLog binds run_id/agent/round/runs_dir and emits the timeout/retry/failed LOG events (split to keep _call.py <=150 code lines). Relationship to the gatekeeper's own retry: the gatekeeper retries the RATE/throughput concern INSIDE execute; this wrapper composes AROUND execute to add the TURN_TIMEOUT_S + turn-failure semantics — no double-counting. TURN-FAILED POLICY: turn.py catches TurnFailedError and returns a DebateMessage marker (new field failed=True on DebateMessage, content=constants.TURN_FAILED_CONTENT) — NOT appended to the opponent's context; loop.py records it in the transcript and returns None as the opponent_message so the opponent gets a fresh anchor rather than rebutting a failure marker. The debate never crashes; it runs all rounds, recording failed turns. New constants: TURN_TIMEOUT_EVENT_TYPE='timeout', TURN_RETRY_EVENT_TYPE='retry', TURN_FAILED_EVENT_TYPE='system', TURN_FAILED_TAG='model_call', TURN_FAILED_CONTENT (no hard-coded values; turn_timeout_s+max_retries from DebateConfig, backoff base from gatekeeper config). Seams: sleep_fn + timeout_runner injected so tests are deterministic + FAST (no real threads/sleeping). TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_turn_timeout.py (6 tests: hanging call times out -> timeout event logged -> retried (retry event) -> succeeds; succeeds on retry returns result with exponential backoff delays asserted via injected sleep_fn; exhausting retries raises TurnFailedError + logs system 'turn_failed' event for the controller; non-transient ValueError NOT retried; failed turn does NOT crash the debate (loop runs, both turns marked failed); call routes through the gatekeeper), watched it fail (ModuleNotFoundError: engine._call), then implemented. turn.py + loop.py wired; existing test_debate_loop.py kept green (run_debate_turn gained sleep_fn/timeout_runner with defaults, backward-compatible). Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check = All checks passed; ruff format --check clean; mypy = Success in 132 source files; pytest --cov = 505 passed, total 100% (engine/_call.py + _call_log.py + turn.py + loop.py + result.py all 100%, >=85); check_line_limit pass (test_turn_timeout.py trimmed to <=150 code lines, split not compress); secret_scan pass. See PR CI for the authoritative result.
